row.title: Apply the defined start of data collection as the PASS start date
row.statement: For PASS, the marketing authorisation holder must treat the study start date as the start of data collection: the date the first study subject's information is first recorded in the study dataset or, for secondary use of data, the date data extraction starts; simple database counts to support protocol development do not count as start of data collection.
